what: A strip of English letters flows on a canvas around the panel (within 18px of the edge) clockwise at 50px per second (top → right → bottom running backwards → left), wrapping the panel like wrapping paper — at widths of 767px and below it runs .8× as fast with the top and bottom edges removed, sides only. Pinned over the white frame around the screen, it runs anywhere on the page

options.text: Text to scroll, defaults to the element’s aria-label — four spaces are appended to the end and it repeats
options.sp: Speed multiplier at 767px and below, default .8
options.size: Font size (px), default 10 — weight 700, font --kf-font-display, color --kf-accent
options.sides: ”lr” means sides only even on desktop, default is all four sides (phones always sides only)

note: Under this plate, the original lays a 28px white border (::before) and a 22px white block covering the two lower corners so the text lines sit on top of the frame — the Frame is left to the consumer’s CSS

from.where: .ns-frame on every page (site name on the white frame around the screen)
